summary: Verified iteration 2 P1 features: sortable dashboard columns, CSV export (with empty-state toast), and per-lead activity notes (add/delete/persist/shortcut). Backend endpoints (POST/DELETE notes, 400 on empty, 404 on missing lead) all pass via curl. Frontend flow passes end-to-end.
passed: GET /api/leads returns leads with `notes` array field
POST /api/leads/{id}/notes with valid body returns 200 and appends note
Dashboard loads with export CSV button and sortable headers
Sortable column business_name: asc/desc toggle works and rows reorder correctly
CSV export downloads with exact expected header order: lead_id,business_name,customer_name,customer_phone,service_category,lead_source,status,received_time,customer_message,notes_count
CSV export row count matches visible leads (5 rows for unfiltered)
Empty search filter yields no download and shows 'Nothing to export' toast
Lead Detail notes-panel visible; submit button disabled on empty input
Adding a note via click works and appears in notes-list; notes-count updates
Ctrl+Enter shortcut submits a note from the textarea
Note delete via hover-revealed trash icon (force click) removes the note and decrements notes-count
